name: Invoify
title: Invoify: free Billdu alternative
hook: Billdu charges you eight bucks a month to make invoices for your clients. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Fill in a form, get an invoice.
features.say: Watch it update live as you type.
Pick from thirteen templates, then download a real PDF.
Save your clients once, and everything stays in your browser.

install_line: It runs in any browser. Nothing to install.
caption:
Billdu charges $7.99/month. Invoify makes your invoices as real PDFs for free 🧾

✅ Fill in a form and watch the invoice update live
✅ 13 templates, then download a real PDF
✅ Save your clients once; your data stays in your browser
✅ No account, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Any browser
ℹ️ Heads up: it's a web app, and invoices are saved in your browser, so clearing site data wipes them (export them as JSON first)

Comment "INVOICE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
